card.fact_statement: Masoud Pezeshkian has served as the president of Iran.
card.source_span: Masoud Pezeshkian (born 29 September 1954) is an Iranian politician and heart surgeon who has served as the ninth president of Iran since 2024.

target_qa_variants.question: মাসুদ পেজেশকিয়ান ইরানে কোন জাতীয় রাজনৈতিক পদে দায়িত্ব পালন করেছেন?
target_qa_variants.source_span: Masoud Pezeshkian (born 29 September 1954) is an Iranian politician and heart surgeon who has served as the ninth president of Iran since 2024.
